body:
## Result and scope

Refs #479

- Claim comment URL and session: https://github.com/hairer/humanise-yang-mills/issues/479#issuecomment-6932410501 (`ADB991-claude-20261116-81c1`)
- Unit IDs or other outputs: YM-000026. The PR adds `blueprint/units/YM-000026/reviews/terminology-477-review-ADB991-claude-20261116-81c1.md` and `Bots/notes/479-20261116T2330Z-ADB991-claude-20261116-81c1.md`. It does not change `manuscript/` or `unit.json`.
- Human contributors and agent assistance: Claude (Anthropic), working as a scheduled agent under ADB991's account. No human has reviewed this report.

This is a report-only, independent check of whether the terminology pass in #477 (`9ded0b7a..962ac43b`, 180 `.tex` files) preserves the mathematics.

**What it establishes**
- No changed mathematical statement, constant or exponent was found.
- Label, `\eqref` and `\cite` key sets are unchanged. One section label and seven references were added, and all of them resolve.
- I read all 108 hunks that touch math tokens.
- The new explicit definitions agree with the pinned Lean source:
  - `puffs(L)=L^{1/8}`, with consistent exponent arithmetic;
  - `\mathfrak M(s,\eta)=e^\eta s!/\eta^s`, which matches `momentPrice`;
  - `R_supp(t)=4(R+2)`, which matches `YM.Trace.Zn.puff`.
- Merging `CTax` and `circleTax` into `Cauchy` is legitimate, because both have the same recursion.
- At every converted use of the grade dilation, `d` is the grade in scope.

**Requested changes (notation)**
- S1: the renames create overloaded symbols in four places.
  - `\omega(w,s)` and `\omega_{a,P}(U)` appear in the same subsection of trace-coffer-supplier.tex.
  - `\omega_w` and `\omega_{N,m,i}` both appear in fullmesh-correlation-cauchy.tex.
  - `\mathcal B_{\rm row}` and `\mathcal B_{t_k}` both appear in stationary-output-construction.tex.
  - `\mathcal N_r` and `\mathcal N_i` both appear in rg-construction.tex.
- S2: the new `\mathcal N`, `\mathcal B_{\rm …}` and `\mathfrak M` families are missing from the symbolic index, which already uses `\mathcal N_d` for a different object.
- S3: the dilation conversion is incomplete. reference-cone.tex still writes a bare `D_L`, and primary-calibration-producer.tex writes `\mathscr V_L`.

**Editorial findings**
- N1: some old terms remain in prose although their definitions were renamed: "toll", "chip", "mouth", "rail"/"plank", "stain" and "escrow".
- N2: five new duplicated words or misspellings, for example "witness witness" and "decompositiones".
- N3: two garbled phrases, at free-kernel-components.tex:33 and in the trace-clock-cap.tex heading.

The report gives file:line locators for every finding.

**What remains uncertain or unchecked**
- Prose-only substitutions such as `same`→`common` and `history`→`trajectory` were sampled, not read in full.
- No LaTeX rebuild was done, because no `.tex` file changed.
- No Lean command was run. The Lean comparisons are textual.

## Evidence

- Pinned source revision: Lean `3456e5e75cf8d4cd558955a5c7638fba2d68f464`, unchanged. Manuscript trees: `40777beb` (before) and `d422b163` (after).
- Commands actually run and results:
  - `python3 scripts/check_blueprint.py`: "Blueprint structure OK: 4 units".
  - `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests`: 22 tests OK.
  - `git diff --check`: clean.
  - Token-alignment scripts: 525 distinct substitutions and 108 hunks that touch math tokens. The method is in the Bots note.
- Checks not performed and why:
  - LaTeX build, because no `.tex` file changed.
  - Lean elaboration, because no Lean claim is made beyond textual definition matches.
  - A full reading of the prose-only renames.
- Dependency/interface changes and affected units: none. The new files are not in any unit's `manuscript` list, so no fingerprints change.

## Review and handoff

- [x] The scope matches the task and has no duplicate declaration ownership.
- [x] Source citations and hypotheses have been checked, where applicable. Three Lean definitions were checked textually.
- [ ] Applicable literature results were sought; substantive steps have detailed proofs or verified references. Not applicable: this PR reviews an editorial diff.
- [x] Structural checks pass.
- [x] Draft/reviewed status is accurate; stale reviews were cleared or renewed. No status is changed.
- [x] The issue has a handoff and links to any durable Bots notes.

Required next review: the manuscript author fixes S1–S3, preferably also N1–N3, and a human decides whether the terminology pass is accepted.
